::: {#exm-absolute-value}
#### Absolute value with `if`

The absolute value
$$
\abs{x} =
\begin{cases}
-x & \text{if } x < 0, \\
x & \text{otherwise}
\end{cases}
$$
has two cases, so one `if` (@def-if-cond) is enough:

```{racket}
#| code-fold: false
(define (absolute x)
  (if (< x 0)
      (- x)
      x))
```

Applied to $-7$ and to 2, it returns their absolute values:

```{racket}
#| code-fold: false
(absolute -7)
(absolute 2)
```

Racket already has this function, under the name `abs`.

:::
